source_message:
feat: migrate-gateway-to-openclaw-user.sh — diagnostic + migration plan

scripts/migrate-gateway-to-openclaw-user.sh (+x):
- default (no flags): read-only diagnostic over SSH — shows openclaw current
  shell, home, running user, systemd service status
- prints 5-step migration plan without executing anything (QRAA-safe)
- --execute flag required for any live changes (shell change, config copy,
  systemd unit update, service restart)

Migration plan when --execute:
  1. usermod -s /bin/bash openclaw
  2. cp config /root/.openclaw-moa/ → /home/openclaw/.openclaw/
  3. chown -R openclaw:openclaw /home/openclaw/.openclaw/
  4. Update systemd unit: User=openclaw, OPENCLAW_HOME=/home/openclaw/.openclaw
  5. daemon-reload + restart + health check

Usage: bash scripts/migrate-gateway-to-openclaw-user.sh          # diagnosis
       bash scripts/migrate-gateway-to-openclaw-user.sh --execute  # live run

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
